描述_EN: porcelain covered with brown lacquer inlaid with mother-of-pearl to represent a party of friends seated on a bank and admiring the landscape, and a boy approaching with a qin (zither). jar and lid, of globular form. diaper borders above and below.
描述_ZN: 瓷器上覆盖着棕色的漆，上面镶嵌着珍珠母，表现了一群朋友坐在岸上欣赏风景，一个男孩拿着琴走过来。 罐子和盖子，呈球状。 上、下两层的尿布边。
